title: Generalized Star Height at Most Four
main_claim: Every regular language over any finite alphabet has generalized star height at most 4 (Theorem 1.1), proved by three applications of a split identity (heights 0→2→3→4) on a prefix-code episode parsing, with finite Boolean affine/basis recoveries in between, and with compilation of every component language at height ≤1 over Σ itself.
coverage: I read all 7 sections in full and checked them by hand. Algebra: the split lemma (soundness through the prefix-code alignment; height max{2,b+1}), affine recovery, and the affine-line local-lemma argument (conditional independence along coordinate lines, the dependency count q_U(1+l(m-1)+C(l,2)(m-1)^2)-1, and the u=1/(2D) estimate). Clock lemma: C_I+C_J covers all six residues; the 1/24 separation for left-tag differences against 2/100 for right tags; the first-coordinate exclusion of competitor pairs, including the cases that share one tag; the reverse-pair contradiction; the distinctness of the 2^j differences; and the forest/spanning-forest bound of 4F^2 bad pairs per batch. Scales: the marker rule and periodic-extension overlap (K>3d^2); boundary congruences, using lcm(d,σN)=dN because d/σ is coprime to N; transport (same class mod dN, margins from H, c^{m+kN}=c^m in reading order); the inner-ambiguity descending count (at most Z exceptional coordinates since the intervals (S_r,S'_r] are disjoint, the swept range is below d_∘, at most 3Z+1 values per nonexceptional coordinate, and difference tuples determine slots via the Reed–Solomon distance k_0); and the growth of P^{k_0} against P^{2Z}. Episodes: the end-ambiguity bound 2|Δ_0|; placement and sidedness (G/2 exceeds H+r_∘+R_r); the prefix code; and the end guard, including too-early and too-late suffixes. Splits: main soundness in the diagonal and off-diagonal clock cases, and completeness via gcd(δ_r,n)=1, transport of later products and of the B_l-to-b product, and diam H<w. I also checked the D_0/D_1 definitions against the decoders, the stage-0 decoder (A_1 absence giving A_0 at the true origin, then uniqueness bounded by C_0), the stage-1 decoder (bounded decoding before the exact end, bounded by C_1), the total tables being computable from suffix data because of the 1,0 buffer order, the linear part [v,1]↦[g_i(v),1], and sequence recovery. Compilation: the template lemma (ultimately periodic data and the a b^{h0}(b^f)^* c expressions), the single unbounded search per component including standalone wrong-guess suffixes, the remainder F=¬(EΣ^*) with its templates, and the final assembly ∪A_dF_f. I ran no machine computation; every check needed was a hand inequality.
sibling_notes: Family 134 siblings (Height-3 at rank 314, Uniform-13 at rank 331) both reported no_gap_found and share the clock, marker and end-guard machinery. Their checks agree with mine on the shared lemmas. This paper's distinctive parts (the multiscale polynomial roster with usable scales and the two aligned decoders A_0/A_1) also check out.
